About Paola Setic

Design that makes a statement & leaves a mark.

I'm Paola Setic, a Graphic Designer based in Pula, Croatia. With over 5 years of experience in creative direction and visual design, I collaborate with dynamic startups, local businesses, and global brands to create work with genuine personality.

I strongly believe great design should feel like it couldn't have been created by anyone else—chic, precise, and unforgettable.

02

04

Got Questions?

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know before kicking off your project with Paola Setic.

How is project payment structured?
+
We operate on a standard 50% deposit upon proposal sign-off and 50% upon final project delivery and asset sign-off.
What file formats will I receive upon handover?
+
For Branding: full vector files (AI, SVG, PDF, EPS) and high-res images (PNG, JPG). For Web: organized Figma design files and optimized code packages. For 3D: 4K PNG renders and OBJ/FBX files where applicable.
How many revision rounds are included?
+
All project scopes include 2 comprehensive revision rounds per phase (concept exploration & final refinement), ensuring the outcome perfectly aligns with your vision.
Do you work with international clients outside Croatia?
+
Absolutely! Based in Pula, Croatia, I collaborate remotely with clients worldwide across Europe, North America, and beyond with smooth communication and video calls.
